facts: Deed from Jill Barrow to her nephew Cameron Barrow, residential parcel, $1 consideration, described as keeping it in the family. Cameron occupies the home and makes no commercial use of it.

expected.notes: TRAP — nephew is NOT in the 27a(7)(u) enumerated class (mother, father, brother, sister, son, daughter, adopted son, adopted daughter, grandson, granddaughter). Sympathetic facts, no exception. Expected uncapping.
